_comment: Operator-authored CRM connector spec for backend/crm_sync.py. Copy to spec.json and edit. Secrets (DSN, pseudonym key) live in .env, NOT here. The SQL must be a single read-only SELECT against a SELECT-only DB role. REVIEW field_actions carefully: 'keep' emits a column verbatim and MUST only be used for confirmed non-personal fields; PII columns must be 'drop' or 'pseudonymize'.
query: SELECT customer_id, segment, status, product, contact_email, notes FROM crm.customer_summary
